stage_1_hero_still.prompt: An original androgynous figure, late-20s read, angular symmetrical bone structure, high flat cheekbones, deep-set deep-brown eyes, one small mole below the inner-left eye, even ambiguous mid-tone complexion, matte natural skin texture with visible pores. Wearing a structured charcoal wool overcoat over a bone-white cotton crew, raw-hem black tailored trousers. Standing in still contrapposto inside a vast brutalist concrete monument interior, board-formed concrete meeting bone-white plaster, a single doorway aperture behind. Single soft key light at 45 degrees from slightly above, deep clean falloff, low fill, chiaroscuro, cool north-light neutral, no colored light. 85mm portrait framing, chest-up, shallow depth of field, generous negative space, centered architectural composition. Quiet luxury editorial, Adobe Neutral palette of charcoal, bone and graphite with a single sparing oxblood accent. Composed-neutral expression.
stage_1_hero_still.negative_prompt: plastic or waxy skin, beauty-filter smoothing, extra or fused fingers, teal-and-orange grade, any logo or text, busy or cluttered background, symmetrical AI face-melt, uncanny dead eyes, broad toothy smile, resemblance to any real or famous person, saturated primaries, lens flare
stage_1_hero_still.post_gen: os_crs.py verifycrop axis_hero_v2.png -> read -> gate; if pillars hold + mole missing -> logged mark-injection -> re-gate

stage_2_motion_clip.prompt: From the hero still: the figure breathes and shifts weight almost imperceptibly, a slow quarter-turn of the head toward the key light, the coat settling. Fine dust motes drift through the raking light. The camera holds nearly static, a 2 percent slow push. Dialogue-free. Composed, restrained motion only, in-register.
stage_2_motion_clip.negative_prompt: warping or melting edges, boiling texture, extra or fused fingers in motion, face morph, identity drift, flicker, out-of-register broad gestures, teal-orange grade, logos or text, lens flare, plastic skin
stage_2_motion_clip.notes: 4:5 is not offered by seedance_2_0; 3:4 (0.75) is the closest editorial vertical and matches the hero still aspect for clean image-to-video.
